LESSON: VIRTUES IN ISLAM PROMISE MANAGEMENT

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Akhlaq (Moral Teachings)
Topic 5.2: Virtues in Islam promise management

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Virtues in Islam promise management
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How can Muslims manage anger?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain the teachings on fulfilment of promise and anger management according to the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.)
2. describe ways in which Muslims can manage anger for harmonious co-existence in the society
3. practise fulfilment of promise and anger management as commanded in Islam
4. appreciate fulfilment of promise and anger management as virtues in Islam
